description: Header file defining the RpcWithAutograd class, which wraps RPC commands with autograd information for distributed autograd in PyTorch.

classes.name: RpcWithAutograd
classes.description: A class representing an RPC with autograd information, wrapping another RpcCommandBase and including metadata, tensors, and device mapping.

methods.name: RpcWithAutograd
methods.description: Constructs an RpcWithAutograd object for sending or receiving RPCs with autograd info.

methods.name: toMessageImpl
methods.description: Serializes the RPC with autograd info into a message.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an RpcWithAutograd object from a received message.

methods.name: tensors
methods.description: Returns the tensors involved in the RPC for autograd computations.

methods.name: autogradMetadata
methods.description: Returns the autograd metadata associated with this RPC.

methods.name: moveWrappedRpc
methods.description: Moves the wrapped RPC command out of this object.

methods.name: wrappedMessageType
methods.description: Returns the message type of the wrapped RPC.

methods.name: fromWorkerId
methods.description: Returns the worker ID from which the RPC originated.

methods.name: deviceMap
methods.description: Returns the device map for tensors involved in the RPC.
